title: Dear Amazon A-to-Z Guarantee Team,
content: Dear Amazon A-to-Z Guarantee Team,We have recently reviewed your message regarding my Amazon Turkey customer account, in which you state that you have noticed a high number of refund requests across my orders. This is the second time I have received a message from you that I consider to be a threat, and I find this approach inappropriate.You should be sending this message to the seller, not to me. The product in question is a $1 item, completely unrelated to the image shown, and the seller is clearly at fault.I have been an Amazon customer since 1997, dating back to when I was living in the United States. Even back then, Amazon was already handling home deliveries efficiently, which is exactly why the company grew and became what it is today.Yes, of course, there are times when certain products do not meet my expectations and I return them. This is precisely why customers trust Amazon and feel confident making purchases. I place 15–20 orders per day across platforms such as Amazon, Trendyol, and Hepsiburada, and I have never encountered such a threatening tone from any of them.If necessary, we can escalate this matter to Amazon US and discuss it directly with them. Customers like me can easily move to other platforms such as Trendyol or Hepsiburada without any consequences, but Amazon risks losing loyal customers by handling situations this way.Additionally, if I receive a product shipped from abroad that is worth less than $1 and does not match its description, I will of course return it. Otherwise, this would be enabling a scam.
